title: Agent late for pickup or not responding
summary: Job is accepted but the agent hasn't arrived and the window is nearly over.

n1.q: Is the agent a rookie (not subcon, fleet, Gold or Platinum)?

end: These agents are skipped on the At Risk check.
If the customer is chasing, WhatsApp the agent for an ETA and update the customer.

n2.q: Does the agent reply with a realistic ETA?

opts.label: No reply / GPS far from pickup

end: Mark the job checked on the At Risk Dashboard with the ETA as the reason.
Update the customer with the ETA.
Ask the seller to push the pickup time, or move to the next slot.
Call the buyer and log it in the Move-over file.
Outsource via the Lalamove API (never SGH — refer to Hamyzan).
Update the customer with the new ETA.
